source_decisions.source_disposition: MainClass.Database physical name, DataBaseName display label, connstr mutable string, originalConnStr shared backup, MainClass.conn last factory object and captured window connections are separate state. Login chooses physical SelectedValue versus display Text; startup persists the physical name. Home.checkConn writes Database and its own connection but not connstr; Home.Loaded later recaptures ConnObj. Login MARS strings and later LoadBranches rewrites are path-specific, not a universal provider configuration.
source_decisions.limit: No session/year deployment mapping, successful login, MARS behavior, live credentials, branch authorization, cloud DTO state or event order certified. P1-009/017/031 and P2-003/012 retain their existing fields. StartupData.json values were never opened.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Both show handlers back up/switch the global string only when the shared flag and a nonnull selected value are present. On normal return from ShowResult/ShowAccountData, they restore connstr, set the flag false and create a new window connection, without clearing the visible year. A second click without a selection event therefore does not repeat the previous-year switch: direct support for existing P7-115. The main statement sets the flag even for inserted index zero; the detailed balance requires index >0.
source_decisions.limit: Normal-tail restoration is not finally. The inner show methods catch ordinary query exceptions, so an ordinary caught SQL failure is NOT asserted to skip restoration. Only a propagating exception that actually escapes before the tail can skip it. No financial misstatement or database collision observed.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Three sale bodies and the guarded contract body optionally overwrite the shared backup/string with a trusted-auth previous-database expression, replace local conn, then CLR before calling a void InsertFromInv helper. On normal helper return they still apply the new/ref/payment/date/item tail, with no accepted-result guard, own restore or CheckBeforeClear. Helpers can return before binding if search is not accepted. This extends the existing P7-160 parent/modal-result root, without making a new numbered finding. Contract button wiring exists in SetupButtonEvents called from frmcontract_Load, despite no XAML Click attribute. Its year combo is collapsed in the selected XAML.
source_decisions.limit: No actual cancellation, lost draft, saved wrong-database invoice, eligibility balance or runtime reachability of a particular contract-year selection is observed. A normal helper return is not hydration success. Parent fields, factory consumers and captured connections are distinguished. CLR/helper/setter exceptions can cut the tail short; no rollback is invented.

source_decisions.source_disposition: The explicit close button restores connstr and clears ReturnYearPreviews. Escape calls Close directly, not that button handler. Enter/double-click/return-button acceptance writes ISDone and InvGlobalID; it does not add database provenance. _conn is readonly and captured at construction. Query branches distinguish InvContratct from Inv, use type/proc and a branch predicate except the selected InvType14 branch. A string restore cannot rewrite a previously constructed connection.
source_decisions.limit: No comprehensive native-close/routed-command/alias/reflection census, row eligibility or provider result is certified. Selected XAML root has no Closing declaration; that is not a proof that no external close behavior exists. Search cancellation and acceptance have different written tails.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Selected-items button calls a void helper, then restores connstr if the shared flag is true, but does not clear the flag; this tail can also follow a no-selection or caught-helper return. All-items marks done and restores string plus clears flag before Close. CloseWithoutResult resets the appropriate local model and ISDone=false, then closes without restoring the session; explicit cancel and Escape use it. Constructor-captured readonly _conn still supplies SQL after changes to the global string. Contract invcontract is distinct from inv in declarations/helper assignment, while selected-row modification/removal loops through inv.InvoiceItems.
source_decisions.limit: No SQL/WPF result or SDK collection defaults, cloning/alias semantics or actual filtered contract list certified. Per-item-id selection behavior is only source evidence here, not a new item-identity root. Missing DTO definitions cannot be presumed to repair the local cross-model path. Remaining readable-local caller/DTO boundary review stays explicit.

source_decisions.source_disposition: The two report detail buttons pass Tag bound to DgvGenralNo. Balance rows source it from Entry.GlobalID; selected statement SQL fragments alias es.EntryGlobalID. ShowEntrySource(string glid) constructs a fresh current-global connection, resolves Entry by GlobalId, then uses loaded Entry.id and branch to search Inv and route local document ids. It has no originating database/year argument. Selected previous-year report rows may therefore outlive the restored global database context. This is a conditional provenance source question, not an assertion of an actual colliding key or wrong opened document.
source_decisions.limit: Full dispatcher body was read, including empty return, invoice six arms and other entry-type arms. This does NOT mean every child receiver or every caller has been read or compiler-bound. No universal allowed-set/ACL/hydration/Found/Empty/Failed/Partial contract certified; remaining receiver/caller work is local, not an unavailable SDK handoff.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Year_Previews is a readable local mapping of display Dbname to physical DbAutoName, with id PK and IS_Deleted, not a financial-year component added to invoice keys. The settings caller passes both local row names to the parameterized delete-by-label/insert writer; the selected delete writer and loader were also read. Login master catalog lookup is distinct from the per-database Year_Previews lists. Selected DDL is resource text, not deployed schema.
source_decisions.limit: No live master catalog contents, grants, uniqueness of mapped database/year/tenant, success of delete+insert or deployed patch execution certified. The settings writer has no shown transaction around delete+insert; no failure/interleaving is claimed. Its full surrounding settings/database-management path and deployment comparison remain local/contract work, respectively, not accepted completion handoffs.
